_comment: Origins, difficulty and victory goals chosen at New Game (player/scenarios.js, core/difficulty.js, systems/victory.js). Normal difficulty is 1 on every knob and must stay so.

wanderer.name: The Wanderer
wanderer.blurb: No name, no lands, no debts. A few coins, the clothes on your back and the open road. Work, trade and fight your way up: the world is yours to read.
wanderer.welcome: You are a wanderer in a {mapDesc} world of {kingdoms} kingdoms. Click on the map to move, explore settlements, and forge your destiny.

disinherited.name: The Disinherited
disinherited.blurb: A younger child of royal blood, cast out when your elder sibling took the family's favour. A real but weak claim on a throne, a House with some name, little gold, and a sibling who wants you gone.
disinherited.title: Disinherited
disinherited.welcome: Your blood runs back to the throne of {kingdom}, but {rival} has your family's favour and wants you gone. Your claim is weak (strength {claim}): marry well, serve the crown, or buy heralds until it can be pressed.

apprentice.name: Guild Journeyman
apprentice.blurb: Bound to a guild of a busy town as a journeyman: guild rates on your inputs, a little stock to sell, the trade in your hands, and a master you still owe for your indenture.
apprentice.title: Journeyman
apprentice.welcome: You are a journeyman of the {guild} of {town}. You owe your old master {debt} gold, paid weekly from your purse: miss three payments and the guild will cast you out.

exiled_monarch.name: The Exiled Monarch
exiled_monarch.blurb: You wore the crown of a realm until a usurper took it. A strong claim, a few loyal swords, a chest of gold and a realm in turmoil. Raise your banners while the succession is still disputed.
exiled_monarch.title: Exiled Monarch
exiled_monarch.welcome: {ruler} sits on your throne in {kingdom}, and the realm is split over it. Your claim is strong (strength {claim}) and loyal swords ride with you. Open Claims & Crowns from the Dynasty menu to press it before the dispute settles.

pirate_widow.name: The Pirate's Widow
pirate_widow.blurb: Your late spouse sailed under no flag. You inherited the sloop, the crew and a name the sea-lords whisper. A coastal start with a ship of your own.
pirate_widow.title: Widow of the Sea
pirate_widow.welcome: The {ship} rides at anchor in {town}, crewed and yours. The sea remembers your late spouse: some captains will know your colours (infamy {infamy}).

sellsword.name: Sellsword Captain
sellsword.blurb: You lead a small free company: hard men, wages owed every day, and a debt to the crown that paid for their gear. Fight for coin, or find something better to fight for.
sellsword.title: Sellsword Captain
sellsword.welcome: Your company of {men} is camped by {town}. They want their wages every day, and you owe {debt} gold to {lender}: take a contract at a town's board before the purse runs dry.

easy.name: Easy
easy.blurb: A richer start, kinder markets, fewer wars, softer foes, gentler sickness.

hard.name: Hard
hard.blurb: A leaner purse, sharper merchants, quicker wars, tougher foes, deadlier sickness.

brutal.name: Brutal
brutal.blurb: Next to nothing in your purse, a world that cheats you, hates you, outfights you and sickens you.

none.name: Sandbox
none.blurb: No goal: live as you please.

crown.name: Wear a Crown
crown.blurb: Rule a kingdom: win a throne by civil war, or found a realm of your own.

merchant_prince.name: Merchant Prince
merchant_prince.blurb: Reach a net worth of {target} gold (gold, deposits, goods, properties, works, ships, company and bank, less debts).

dynasty.name: Dynasty
dynasty.blurb: Keep your House alive for {generations} generations or {years} years.

monopoly.name: Monopolist
monopoly.blurb: Hold {target} trade monopolies at once (won by your company's lobbying or granted by your crown).

conqueror.name: Conqueror
conqueror.blurb: Hold {target} settlements in your own hands.
